# --instructions--

文字列の配列を受け取り（引数ラベルは省略）、重複を取り除いた残りの値を昇順に並べた新しい配列を返す関数`dedupe`を書いてください

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`dedupe(["b", "a", "b", "c", "a"])`は`["a", "b", "c"]`を返さなければなりません

```swift
tryCatch(dedupe(["b", "a", "b", "c", "a"]) == ["a", "b", "c"])
```

`dedupe(["x", "x", "x"])`は`["x"]`を返さなければなりません

```swift
tryCatch(dedupe(["x", "x", "x"]) == ["x"])
```

`dedupe([])`は空の配列を返さなければなりません

```swift
tryCatch(dedupe([]) == [])
```

この関数は文字列の配列を返さなければなりません

```swift
tryCatch(type(of: dedupe(["a"])) == [String].self)
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func dedupe(_ items: [String]) -> [String] {
    return Set(items).sorted()
}
```
